formal_router_weapons.summary: Repeated exact factor/gcd/valuation descent reduces a receiver square condition to a finite exhaustive squareclass branch family before low-genus closure.

With a certified full MW group and all torsion translates, exact good-prime residue conditions plus generalized CRT can prove global absence of parent-compatible quotient points without a bounded multiplier search.
Close the exact receiver by proving branch plus receiver condition has empty or degenerate intersection, without claiming the larger factor-cover rational point set is complete.

formal_workflows.summary: A theorem-shaped Class3 kernel may be discharged by a replacement theorem matching the exact receiver quantifiers, using exhaustive finite reduction and proof-capable quotient closure; the originally named theorem species need not itself be proved.
